pageHelp.automation.body: Automation runs a list of steps against your profiles. That list is a project: every click and keystroke goes through the browser’s own human-input engine, so a page sees a person and not a script. Modules are files you write that add steps of their own: open a project, choose “Add step”, then “Manage modules”.
pageHelp.automation.title: Giới thiệu automation
pageHelp.bookmarks.body: A bookmark you add to a Thư mục shows up in every profile in that Thư mục. You Lưu a site once instead of in each browser. Pick a Thư mục to see what its profiles get.
pageHelp.bookmarks.title: Giới thiệu Dấu trang
pageHelp.extensions.body: An extension adds a feature to a profile’s browser, such as an ad blocker. Add one here, then turn it on for each profile in its details panel (Peek). Dán a Web Store link, or add a .crx, .zip or unpacked Thư mục.
pageHelp.extensions.title: Giới thiệu Tiện ích mở rộng
pageHelp.fingerprints.body: A Dấu vân tay is the hardware identity a profile shows to sites, such as its GPU and screen. This library holds the ones new profiles are built on, and each is checked against this computer’s GPU. Import your own to add more.
pageHelp.fingerprints.title: Giới thiệu the Dấu vân tay library
pageHelp.profiles.body: A profile is one browser identity: its own Dấu vân tay, Cookie, Proxy and Cài đặt, kept apart from every other profile. Create one, then start it to open its browser. Sort profiles into Thư mục and Chế độ xem, and use Peek to look at one without leaving the list.
pageHelp.profiles.title: Giới thiệu profiles
pageHelp.proxies.body: A Proxy is the address a profile connects through, so sites see the Proxy’s location and not this computer’s. Add SOCKS5 or HTTP Proxy here, check that they work, and assign them to profiles. You can also buy Proxy from ProxyShard.
pageHelp.proxies.title: Giới thiệu Proxy
pageHelp.proxyshard.body: ProxyShard is the Proxy service LPBrower works with. Connect your account with an API key, then see your balance, plan and orders, and buy Proxy for your profiles. The key stays on this computer and goes only to ProxyShard.
pageHelp.proxyshard.title: Giới thiệu ProxyShard
pageHelp.settings.body: Cài đặt control how LPBrower looks and behaves on this computer, and what new profiles start with. Each tab groups one kind of setting. Changes apply once you Lưu them.
pageHelp.settings.title: Giới thiệu Cài đặt
pageHelp.team.title: Giới thiệu this team
pageHelp.team.body: Everyone here works in the team’s own space on its server. Add members, send each their invite, then set what each may do: the narrowest rule wins, and a refusal beats an allowance of the same width.
pageHelp.team.memberBody: You work in this team’s space on its server. What you may do here is set by the team’s admin, and the grid shows it.
pageHelp.trash.body: đã xóa profiles stay here for 7 days. Cookie, logins and site Bộ nhớ are kept; caches are not. Restore a profile to get it Quay lại, or delete it for good.
pageHelp.trash.title: Giới thiệu Thùng rác

tour.form.create.body: Nothing exists until you press “Tạo hồ sơ”. You can change everything later with “Edit”.
tour.form.create.title: Create the profile
tour.form.extensions.body: This is optional. Check the Tiện ích mở rộng this profile should load. The list is your extension library.
tour.form.extensions.title: Add Tiện ích mở rộng
tour.form.fingerprint.body: A Dấu vân tay makes websites see this profile as a particular computer. Choose its Hệ điều hành, then pick a Dấu vân tay from the list.
tour.form.fingerprint.title: Pick a Dấu vân tay
tour.form.locale.body: “Auto (from Proxy)” makes them follow the Proxy’s country, so they match where the profile appears to be. Change them only if you need something else.
tour.form.locale.title: Múi giờ and Ngôn ngữ
tour.form.name.body: A profile is a separate browser with its own logins and Cài đặt. Name it so you recognize it in your list. You can type here now.
tour.form.name.title: Name your profile
tour.form.organize.body: Both are optional. A Thư mục keeps related profiles together, and Thẻ are labels you can Lọc by.
tour.form.organize.title: Thư mục and Thẻ
tour.form.proxy.body: A Proxy is the address a profile connects through, so websites see its location, not yours. Pick one, choose “Không proxy”, or press “Add a new Proxy” to Dán one.
tour.form.proxy.title: Choose a Proxy
tour.formHint: You can see this again from “Show me around” in the form
tour.full.automation.body: A project is a list of steps that runs in a profile’s browser, such as opening a page and clicking a button. “New project” chạy one.
tour.full.automation.title: Automate a profile
tour.full.bookmarks.body: A bookmark you add to a Thư mục shows up in every profile in that Thư mục. You Lưu a page once, not in each browser.
tour.full.bookmarks.title: Dấu trang by Thư mục
tour.full.editor.body: Inside a project you add steps one by one. Press “Lưu” to keep them, then “Run” to play them in your profiles.
tour.full.editor.title: Build, Lưu, run
tour.full.extensions.body: Add Chrome Tiện ích mở rộng here once. Then you choose which ones each profile gets.
tour.full.extensions.title: Add Tiện ích mở rộng
tour.full.fingerprints.body: A Dấu vân tay makes a profile look like a different computer to websites. Pick one from this library when you make a profile, or import your own.
tour.full.fingerprints.title: Ready-made computers
tour.full.help.body: đã xóa profiles wait in Thùng rác, so you can bring them Quay lại. The (i) beside every page title explains that page, and you can replay this tour from Cài đặt.
tour.full.help.title: Thùng rác and help
tour.full.list.body: Each row is one profile, a separate browser with its own Proxy and Dấu vân tay. You can show, move and resize the Cột.
tour.full.list.title: Your profiles
tour.full.listTools.body: “Filters” keeps only the profiles you want to see. “Hiển thị” chooses which Cột the list shows.
tour.full.listTools.title: Narrow the list
tour.full.newProfile.body: “Hồ sơ mới” opens a form where you pick the name, Proxy and Dấu vân tay. The profile exists only once you press “Tạo hồ sơ”.
tour.full.newProfile.title: Make a profile
tour.full.panel.body: Click a profile and its details open beside the list. “Edit” changes it, and nothing changes until you press “Lưu”.
tour.full.panel.title: The details panel (Peek)
tour.full.problems.body: When something needs fixing, such as a Proxy that fails its test, a card appears above the profile list with a button that fixes it.
tour.full.problems.title: Problems to fix
tour.full.proxies.body: Press “Add Proxy” to bring them in, then test that each one works. The list also shows which profiles use each Proxy.
tour.full.proxies.title: Add your Proxy
tour.full.proxyshard.body: See your ProxyShard balance, and buy Lưu lượng or Proxy, without leaving the app. You connect your account with an API key.
tour.full.proxyshard.title: Buy Lưu lượng and Proxy
tour.full.search.body: Find any profile, page or command. Press Ctrl+K, or Cmd+K on macOS, to open it from anywhere.
tour.full.search.title: Tìm kiếm everything
tour.full.settings.body: A change in Cài đặt applies only after you press “Lưu”. A bar with “Lưu” and “Không lưu” appears at the bottom as soon as you change something.
tour.full.settings.title: Lưu your Cài đặt
tour.full.sidebar.body: Every page of LPBrower is in this list: profiles, Proxy, Dấu vân tay and more. Click one to open it.
tour.full.sidebar.title: The sidebar
tour.full.start.body: “Start” opens the profile’s own browser window. Its logins and Cookie stay inside that profile.
tour.full.start.title: Start a profile
tour.full.viewsFolders.body: Lưu a filtered list as a Chế độ xem to open it again in one click. Thư mục keep related profiles together.
tour.full.viewsFolders.title: Chế độ xem and Thư mục
tour.replayHint: You can replay the tour from Cài đặt
tour.tips.automation.editor.body: Inside a project you add steps one by one. Press “Lưu” to keep them, then “Run” to play them in your profiles.

tour.tips.extensions.add.title: Add an extension
tour.tips.extensions.help.body: An extension runs only in the profiles you turn it on for. The (i) explains how.
tour.tips.extensions.help.title: Turned on per profile
tour.tips.fingerprints.help.body: Each Dấu vân tay is checked against this computer’s GPU. The (i) explains the library, and that you can import your own.
tour.tips.fingerprints.help.title: Made for this computer
tour.tips.fingerprints.library.body: Each Dấu vân tay makes a profile look like a different computer to websites. You pick one when you make a profile.
tour.tips.fingerprints.library.title: Ready-made computers
tour.tips.proxies.add.body: Press “Add Proxy” and Dán them in, one per line. Then test them to see which ones work.
tour.tips.proxies.add.title: Add your Proxy
tour.tips.proxies.help.body: A Proxy is the address a profile connects through, so websites see its location and not yours. The (i) explains more.
tour.tips.proxies.help.title: Giới thiệu Proxy
tour.tips.proxyshard.buy.body: See your ProxyShard balance, and buy Lưu lượng or Proxy here, without leaving the app. Your account connects with an API key.
tour.tips.proxyshard.buy.title: Buy Lưu lượng and Proxy
tour.tips.proxyshard.help.body: ProxyShard is the Proxy service LPBrower works with. The (i) explains where your key is kept.
tour.tips.proxyshard.help.title: Giới thiệu ProxyShard
tour.tips.settings.help.body: Each tab groups one kind of setting. The (i) says what you can change here.
tour.tips.settings.help.title: Giới thiệu Cài đặt
tour.tips.settings.save.body: A change in Cài đặt applies only after you press “Lưu”. A bar with “Lưu” and “Không lưu” appears at the bottom as soon as you change something.
tour.tips.settings.save.title: Changes need “Lưu”
